HLPR is an online platform that connects homeowners with Domestic help providers from all around Egypt. 
HLPR platform helps clients find services providers of Home Cleaning, Babysitting, and Home Nursing. 
Not only HLPR Connect the client to the helpers and provide a seamless booking experience. HLPR also train all the domestic helpers to guarantee a consistent quality.
